description: This Java source file defines the class KamonConnectionPoolListener, which implements the MongoDB ConnectionPoolListener interface. It reports MongoDB connection pool statistics to Kamon metrics and manages connection pool events such as pool creation, destruction, connection checkout/check-in, and wait queue events.

classes.name: KamonConnectionPoolListener
classes.description: Implements monitoring of MongoDB connection pool events by reporting metrics to Kamon, including handling pool lifecycle events and connection status changes.

methods.name: connectionPoolOpened
methods.description: Handles the event when a connection pool is opened; initializes metrics for the pool.

methods.name: connectionPoolClosed
methods.description: Handles the event when a connection pool is closed; removes metrics for the pool.

methods.name: connectionCheckedOut
methods.description: Handles a connection being checked out from the pool; increments the checked out count metric.

methods.name: connectionCheckedIn
methods.description: Handles a connection being checked in to the pool; decrements the checked out count metric.

methods.name: waitQueueEntered
methods.description: Handles when a thread enters the connection wait queue; increments wait queue size.

methods.name: waitQueueExited
methods.description: Handles when a thread exits the wait queue; decrements wait queue size.

methods.name: connectionAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of a new connection; increments pool size.

methods.name: connectionRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a connection; decrements pool size.

classes.name: PoolMetric
classes.description: Encapsulates the gauges for tracking pool size, checked out count, and wait queue size per server, providing methods for updating these metrics.

methods.name: connectionPoolOpened
methods.description: Initializes metrics and logs when a connection pool is opened.

methods.name: connectionPoolClosed
methods.description: Removes metrics and logs when a connection pool is closed.

methods.name: connectionCheckedOut
methods.description: Updates metrics when a connection is checked out.

methods.name: connectionCheckedIn
methods.description: Updates metrics when a connection is checked in.

methods.name: waitQueueEntered
methods.description: Updates metrics when wait queue is entered.

methods.name: waitQueueExited
methods.description: Updates metrics when wait queue is exited.

methods.name: connectionAdded
methods.description: Updates metrics when a connection is added to the pool.

methods.name: connectionRemoved
methods.description: Updates metrics when a connection is removed from the pool.
